Gold.note: Slight drawdown and high real rates offset by central bank accumulation.

Silver.note: Double-digit historical drawdown reflects softening industrial demand and weak momentum.

Copper.note: Strong historical performance supported by tight concentrates market and green energy transition.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit and renewed global nuclear capacity additions drive bullish outlook.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply from new projects outweighs long-term EV battery demand growth.

Nickel.note: Persistent supply surplus from Indonesian HPAL projects pressures prices despite historical pullback.

Zinc.note: Strong historical gains reflect mine supply constraints and low smelter treatment charges.

Iron Ore.note: Chinese property sector weakness caps upside despite steady infrastructure and export demand.

Coal.note: Thermal demand plateauing while met coal remains stable, resulting in a neutral macro outlook.

Rare Earths.note: Geopolitical supply risks balanced against currently soft industrial and EV motor demand.

Manganese.note: Steady global steel production provides a neutral baseline for manganese ore demand.

PGM.note: Long-term structural decline in internal combustion engine volumes pressures palladium and platinum.

Potash.note: Stable global agricultural application rates offset by recovering international supply chains.

Aluminum.note: Primary metal demand boosted by lightweighting and solar sectors amid constrained smelter capacity.

Diversified.note: Broad exposure to base and precious metals provides a slight bullish tilt amid global reflation.
